description: Opportunistic flight samples with lot detail, V5 (space-pharmacy.md, Validation datasets).

vectors.description: V5. Opportunistic flight samples with lot detail (MDP04, all 57 rows)

inputs.conditions: Columns as in the file. "Past expiry at analysis" is in months for the Wotring and Cory rows and in days for the Wotring-FDA rows (inferred from the dates; the file does not state units). For Wu rows the file's control is normalized to 100. The azithromycin SpX3 landing date "5/18/2024" is a typo in the file (SpX3 landed in 2014). Levofloxacin in the Cory 2016 rows is listed as 50 mg.
inputs.parse_conventions: 'API % (SD)' as {value, sd}; 'not provided', 'not avail', 'not given', 'NA' parse to null; lot numbers stay strings; dates stay strings as printed (M/D/YYYY); 'up / down' mission cells parse to {items}. past_expiry_unit_inferred is added from the note's statement (months for Wotring and Cory rows, days for Wotring-FDA rows, null for Wu rows); the file does not state units.

vectors.note: Anomalies kept as printed: azithromycin SpX3 landing '5/18/2024' is a typo for 2014; Cory 2016 levofloxacin listed as 50 mg; spellings 'caapsule', 'tables', 'Contro' and the mixed-case arm 'Control' are verbatim from the file. Wotring 2015 rows differ from the paper (V6) for melatonin (90 (3.3) here vs 89.2) and in expiry offsets (8 and 10 months here vs 9 and 11). Use: lot-level checks of sealed or semi-protected products and of assay variability; the Khan and Wotring rows give a second assay of Du lots.
